name: Jezero Crater
description: An ancient river delta, where past water may have left signs of life.

name: Gale Crater
description: A deep crater with a layered mountain that records the climate of early Mars.

name: Meridiani Planum
description: Flat, safe plains rich in minerals that form in water.

name: Utopia Planitia
description: A vast northern basin with ice not far below the surface.

name: Valles Marineris
description: The largest canyon in the solar system, with billions of years of rock laid bare.
